title: Goyal Metal Industries And 2 Others v. State Of U.P. And 2 Others
coram: Dilip B. Bhosale, C.J.; Yashwant Varma, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed following the order of even date in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016.
headnote: Writ challenging demand of additional security under Para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 dismissed by adopting the order of the same date in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016. An earlier Division Bench had connected the petition with similar 4.20 challenges and restrained demand of additional security pending hearing.
facts: Goyal Metal Industries and two others petitioned the Allahabad High Court against the State of U.P. and two others, challenging demand of additional security under Para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. On 4 September 2013 a Division Bench issued notice, connected the writ with W.P. No. 30582 of 2009 (M/s Vehina Steels & Alloys Pvt. Ltd.) and similar matters, and restrained the respondents from demanding additional security until further orders. On 21 March 2017 another Division Bench dismissed the writ.

holding_units.holding: The writ petition challenging demand of additional security under Para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 is dismissed, following the order of even date in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016.
